notes: Ethereum mainnet launch of Swarmlings (LING) paired with IMD, not ETH: pool.pairedCurrency must stay 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7. On chain id 1 the token's rewardCurrency is IMD (src/Swarmlings.sol _chooseRewardCurrency) and the hook binds as launchPool the first IMD / LING pool at static fee 12500 (afterInitialize); a LING / ETH pool would leave the hook inert. test/Manifest.t.sol fails if this manifest pairs with anything else. Token: Swarmlings is a DN404 token with a zero-argument constructor that deploys its NFT contract (SwarmlingsMirror) and mints exactly 1e27 LING to msg.sender (the factory) with skipNFT set. Every whole 300,000 LING held by a wallet is one Swarmling NFT (3,333 max), minted and burned automatically; a transfer that would mint more than 800 NFTs auto-skips them (MAX_MINT_PER_TRANSFER); contracts skip NFTs unless they opt in (EIP-7702 delegated wallets count as wallets), so the factory, PoolManager and distributor never hold any. No admin, proxy, pause, mint after construction or fee on transfer; owner() only labels the marketplace collection and has no power. NFT sales carry a 5% ERC-2981 creator fee paid to the token: half to holders in ETH, half to DEV 0x92cEf4823119f3332A85A39023eEbA01a06890c4 (claimDev pays only that fixed wallet). Rewards (ETH and IMD) that arrive on one UTC day are paid out the next day per second held; claim(), claimEth() and claimToken() pay only the caller's own share; anyone may call syncEth(), syncToken(), addRewards(), SwarmlingsHook.distribute() and a sink's poke(). Hook: SwarmlingsHook(IPoolManager, token) records its deployer (the launch factory) as launcher and never charges the JIT penalty on the factory's positions. All 14 hook flags are set (address low bits 0x3FFF) because it is a router to which primitives can be attached after launch: slices (extra fee to sinks) and modules (buy guards, gas-capped observers, fee quoters). Only SwarmlingsCouncil (constant COUNCIL = 0x4d0b3507D80f678d9e658Fd5482Ca6a96636A032, already deployed, owned by the dev wallet) can change them, at once with a logged memo, within limits fixed in code: total hook fee at most 5% (MAX_FEE_BPS), the holders' 1.25% (HOLDER_FEE_BPS) fixed, no module can block a sell or a liquidity removal. At launch there are no slices and no modules. Fixed behaviour: a 1.25% IMD fee on every buy and sell of any IMD / LING pool using the hook goes entirely to NFT holders, on top of the pool's 1.25% LP fee; modules run only on the launch pool. Snipe tax: for 60 seconds after the launch pool opens, buys pay an extra fee falling linearly from 40% to 0, all to holders; sells are exempt. beforeInitialize and afterInitialize accept only the PoolManager and never reject a pool. initialPrice is written as the launch facts give it (2^96); the deployer opens the pool from the policy's 2,500 IMD opening cap. Requested economics: poolBps 9000, no allocation to the requester (an EOA allocation of 100M LING would mint 333 NFTs inside the launch transaction). LING balances and total supply sit in full low-order storage so forge-std deal works. Creation gas on mainnet: about 4.3M for the token with its NFT contract and about 4.6M for the hook (21.7 KB runtime). Art comes from an immutable renderer at the same CREATE2 address on every chain (0x8d79e6677FA6E52190B39096f8496628811D8281, source in renderer/); until it has code, tokenURI returns a minimal valid JSON. This job only launches the contracts; the site follows in a continuation that reads the live addresses. See README.md and docs/.
